description: This file initializes and documents the usage of expiration timers for managing stuck workers within the torch distributed elastic framework. It imports classes and functions related to timers from its submodules and provides example code demonstrating their setup and usage.

methods.name: main
methods.description: An example setup function demonstrating how to initialize the timer server, create a worker specification, and run an elastic agent with timeout handling.

methods.name: trainer_func
methods.description: A worker function that configures the timer client and sets an expiration, demonstrating the timer's use for worker timeout enforcement.
